text:
lina: Quick kick: "Starter Sprint" 1: small dev-focused launch: 3 micro-tutorials (local, container, Dedicated deploy), tiny demo repo, a short bench post (latency & cost), and a 30-min webinar. Need owners for repo, bench, landing, copy, and lead routing.

owen: i can do the repo + demo app. plan: tiny Go API + static React client, streaming example, include a one-click deploy button. will add a small bench script.

naomi: i'll take the benchmark narrative. propose we compare: hosted default, quantized variant, and Dedicated. metrics: p95, cold-start, cost/1k tokens. short reproducible scripts only.

ben: landing + funnel ownership — recommend open repo CTA + optional RSVP for webinar. funnel: landing -> RSVP modal (email) -> thank-you w/ repo link -> 3-email drip.

sue: i'll handle copy + social. want a 1-line hero + 3 bullets, 2 tweet variants, and a short GIF.

lina: comments: keep tutorials <20 minutes each; bench post should be lightweight and honest about tradeoffs. ben, set up hidden UTMs so ops can route leads.

owen: repo structure idea:
- /starter-sprint-demo
  - /1-local
  - /2-docker
  - /3-dedicated
  - /bench (bench script + sample prompts)
README: quickstart + expected numbers + how to reproduce bench.

naomi: bench outline (short):
1) sample workload: 150 short chat turns
2) models: baseline open, quantized, Dedicated pinned
3) runs: 5 cold starts + 25 simulated short sessions
4) deliverable: small table + two micro-charts + commands to run
will PR bench-harness by Tue EOD.

ben: suggested inbound payload (we'll map to HubSpot):
```
POST /webhooks/lead
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "pat.dev@example.com",
  "name": "Pat Dev",
  "company": "Acme",
  "role": "Engineer",
  "source": "starter_sprint_landing",
  "utm": "social_tease_apr",
  "interests": ["starterkit","bench"]
}
```
will auto-tag with utm + interest.

sue: hero options: "Starter Sprint: ship an LLM demo, fast" or "Ship a real LLM demo in under an hour". i'll write 2 A/B headlines + 3 bullets.

lina: timeline suggestion:
- Mon: repo skeleton + hero copy (owen + sue)
- Tue: bench harness PR (naomi) + GIF draft (owen)
- Wed: landing + tracking live (ben + ops)
- Thu: publish tutorial #1 + social tease (sue)
- Fri: webinar + bench post live

ben: ops note: prefer open RSVP (less friction) with email optional. still include a small form hidden-field for UTMs.

own: GIF plan: 8s clip showing prompt -> streaming response -> latency overlay; produce mp4 + gif. need design thumbnail by Tue.

naomi: will include a short appendix about quantization tradeoffs. keep bench scripts to a single shell + python snippet so devs can run locally.

sue: tweet drafts: 1) "Starter Sprint: 3 bite-size tutorials + mini-benchmark to ship LLM features fast. Repo + 30-min webinar. RSVP: link \ud83d\ude80" 2) "See real latency & cost numbers for small LLM demos. Join our 30-min webinar and try the repo. link"

ops-bot: scheduled: social-tease queued for 2024-04-22T16:00:00Z.

lina: final ask 1: please drop a 1-line status on the Notion checklist by EOD. quick 10-min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT for blockers. thanks all :raised_hands:
